flags.title: No Specification Document
flags.description: No formal specification document received. Technical requirements extracted from drawing notes only.
flags.impact: Cannot confirm material specifications, workmanship standards, or quality requirements beyond drawing notes.
flags.action_required: RFI to consultant for full specification

flags.title: No Earthworks Drawings
flags.description: No earthworks or bulk filling drawings received. Cannot quantify significant earth filling over tunnel structure for wildlife crossing.
flags.impact: Major cost element cannot be measured. Earthworks likely represents significant portion of project value.
flags.action_required: RFI for earthworks details - cut/fill volumes, compaction specs, topsoil depths, drainage

flags.title: Outdated Shukuma Pricing
flags.description: Shukuma estimates dated May 2021 - approximately 4.5 years old.
flags.impact: Combined Shukuma value of R6.28M (excl VAT) requires significant escalation (~40-50% since 2021).
flags.action_required: Request updated quotation from Shukuma Flooring Systems or apply CPI escalation

flags.title: Multiple Drawing Revisions
flags.description: Both S-002P and S-002P-A present in drawing package.
flags.impact: Potential for using superseded information during measurement.
flags.action_required: Clarify with consultant which revision is current for tender

flags.title: No Reinforcement Schedules
flags.description: Foundation drawings show reinforcing layouts but no bar bending schedules provided.
flags.impact: Rebar quantities must be scaled from drawings - reduced accuracy (±15%).
flags.action_required: Request bar bending schedules or confirm measurement approach acceptable

flags.title: SANParks Location
flags.description: Project located within Addo Elephant National Park - SANParks jurisdiction.
flags.impact: Environmental compliance and access restrictions may apply to construction methodology.
flags.action_required: Confirm any specific SANParks requirements affecting measurement/pricing

flags.title: Specialist Supplier Identified
flags.description: Shukuma Flooring Systems (Port Elizabeth) identified as specialist supplier for precast hollow-core flooring. Design engineer: Andries Stücki Pr. Eng.
flags.impact: Nominated subcontractor for precast flooring - pricing structure defined.

flags.title: Terra-Force Blocks Required
flags.description: L11 Terra-Force interlocking blocks shown for retaining walls on site plan and sections.
flags.impact: Specialist interlocking block system required - supply arrangements need confirmation.
flags.action_required: Confirm Terra-Force supply and installation arrangements
